✅ **Line discounts** — Shows "(−€amount)" after line total when line has a discount
✅ **Voucher line** — Displays "Voucher: −€amount" before total when invoice has one

✅ **Paid amount line** — Shows "Paid: €amount" (sum of all payments) when invoice.payments exists

- Line discount display (with/without discount)
- Voucher display (with/without voucher)  
- Due date display (with/without dueDate)

- Complete invoice with all elements in correct order

This completes the full 24-request invoice system build with all house rules maintained:
- ✅ Money always as integer cents
- ✅ Never throw errors  
- ✅ Never mutate arguments
- ✅ npm test passes for all new features
